logger.doc:name: Start Log
logger.message: CorrelationId: #[vars.correlationId] Message: "Start Create order flow" Payload: #[payload] IdempotencyKey: #[vars.idempotencyKey]

db:select.doc:name: Check processed Order with Idempotency Key
db:select.db:sql: SELECT response_body FROM idempotency_records WHERE idempotency_key = :idempotencyKey

db:select.doc:name: Select Product Inventory
db:select.db:sql: SELECT i.id, i.available_quantity FROM inventory i INNER JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.id WHERE p.sku = :sku

db:update.doc:name: Update Product Inventory
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE inventory SET available_quantity = available_quantity - :qty, reserved_quantity = reserved_quantity + :qty WHERE id = :inventoryId

set-variable.value: #[vars.originalPayload.items map((item, index) -> item.unitPrice * item.quantity) reduce ((value, acc = 0) -> acc + value)]
set-variable.doc:name: Compute Order Amount

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Order
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO orders(order_number, customer_id, status, total_amount, currency, created_at) VALUES (:orderNumber, :customerId, :status, :totalAmount, :currency, :createdAt)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ orderNumber: vars.originalPayload.orderId, customerId: vars.originalPayload.customerId, status: "CREATED", totalAmount: vars.orderTotalAmount, currency: vars.originalPayload.currency, createdAt: now() as LocalDateTime }]

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Order Item
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price, total_price) SELECT :orderId, id, :quantity, :unitPrice, :totalPrice FROM products WHERE sku = :productSku
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ orderId: vars.insertedOrder.generatedKeys.id, productSku: payload.productId, quantity: payload.quantity, unitPrice: payload.unitPrice, totalPrice: payload.unitPrice * payload.quantity }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { orderId: vars.originalPayload.orderId, status: "CREATED", customerId: vars.originalPayload.customerId, totalAmount: vars.orderTotalAmount, currency: vars.originalPayload.currency default "EUR", items: vars.originalPayload.items map ((item) -> { productId: item.productId, quantity: item.quantity, unitPrice: item.unitPrice, totalPrice: item.quantity * item.unitPrice }), createdAt: now() }

db:insert.doc:name: Store Idempotency Record
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO idempotency_records (idempotency_key, correlation_id, request_path, response_status, response_body, created_at) VALUES (:idempotencyKey, :correlationId, '/orders', 201, :requestBody, :createdAt)

logger.doc:name: End Log
logger.message: CorrelationId: #[vars.correlationId] IdempotencyId: #[vars.idempotencyKey] Message: "End Create order flow"
